title: 30A Ohana Grande
meta_description: Expansive 9BR oasis near Santa Rosa Beach with a pool, hot tub, game room \& theater. Perfect for large groups seeking sun, fun \& relaxation on 30A!
description_expanded:
Welcome to 30A Ohana Grande by AvantStay --- your own private oasis tucked between the white sands of Santa Rosa Beach and the laid-back charm of Gulf Place. Designed for togetherness without sacrificing space, this expansive nine-bedroom retreat invites you to gather, celebrate, and truly unwind on Florida's beloved Emerald Coast.

With room for up to 23 guests, the home flows seamlessly from sunlit interiors to breezy outdoor spaces. Picture mornings with coffee on the upper balcony, long afternoons lounging by the private pool, and golden-hour dinners at the shaded patio table while something sizzles on the BBQ. The pool's sun shelf and hot tub offer all-day relaxation, while the firepit sets the scene for late-night chats and s'mores under the stars.

Inside, natural light floods the open-concept living room, dining area, and chef's kitchen --- perfect for big meals and bigger memories. A spacious island with barstool seating makes breakfast easy, while high-end appliances elevate every home-cooked meal. Downstairs, a second living area opens via giant sliders to the pool deck for effortless indoor/outdoor living.

Ready for a little friendly competition or a cozy night in? Head to the game room for a round of pool, mix drinks at the wet bar, or kick back in your own private theater --- popcorn encouraged.

An elevator, two sets of washers and dryers, and plenty of parking add a touch of luxury, ease, and convenience to your stay.

And when it's time to explore, you'll be just minutes from 30A's best beaches, boutique shops, and the local flavors of Gulf Place and Blue Mountain Beach.

Whether you're here for a family reunion, a special celebration, or simply to soak up the sun with your favorite people, 30A Ohana Grande is your dream beach escape, with room for everyone.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note that the outdoor firepit is currently not available for guest use.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available for 7 vehicles (6 in the driveway, 1 in the garage).

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
